DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帳面をお預かりしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I take your stamp book?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二冊あります。もう一冊は同行者のものですが、本人に頼まれてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人に頼まれていない同行者の帳面があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have two. The other belongs to my companion, but they haven't asked me to do this.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have your companion's book without their request. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同行者の方のお帳面は、ご本人のご希望をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check your companion's own wishes about their book.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。勝手に記入してもらうところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無断で記入依頼するところだったと認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I was about to have it written in without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you nearly requested an entry without permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身のお帳面は、今回のお申し込みでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like to submit your own book for this request?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、私の一冊だけお願いします。同行者の分は返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の一冊だけ受付を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, just my one book, please. I'll wait for my companion's reply about theirs.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request acceptance of only your own book. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、お客様のお帳面だけお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I'll take only your book.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者から返事が来ました。今日は書いてもらわず持ち帰りたいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の持ち帰り希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My companion has replied. They want to take theirs home without having anything written in it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your companion wants to take their book home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その一冊は、お手元で保管されてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep that book with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。私の受付と混ざらないよう、同行者の帳面はかばんにしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付帳面との混同を避け同行者分を収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I'll put my companion's book in my bag so it won't get mixed up with my submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put your companion's book away to avoid confusion with the submitted book. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同行者のお帳面はお預かりせず、ご本人の分だけ受付を進めます。それでは、ご参拝の時間を穏やかにお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We won't take your companion's book; we'll proceed with only your own. Please enjoy a peaceful visit to the shrine.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうした、手を止めているね。

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手袋が破れました。破れた部分の一部が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手袋破損と破片の所在不明を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My glove tore. I can't find part of the torn section.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the torn glove and missing fragment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に破れていないと確認したのはいつか分かるか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know when you last checked that it was intact?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この工程に入る前です。途中のどこで破れたかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後の無破損確認時点と不明な破損時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Before starting this process. I don't know at what point during it the tear happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the last intact check time and explain the tear's timing is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まずその範囲の製品を動かさず、責任者へ報告しよう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: First, let's leave the products in that range unmoved and report to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手袋だけ交換して続けるのはやめます。触れた製品の範囲を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交換だけで再開せず接触製品の範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't just replace the glove and carry on. I'll show which products I touched.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not resume merely after replacement; show the range of products touched. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記憶だけで範囲を狭めないようにしてくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't narrow the range based only on memory.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確実に言えるところと不明なところを分けます。作業記録も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確実な事実と不明範囲を分け記録で補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll separate what I can say for certain from what is unknown. I'll also check the work records.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish certain facts from the unknown range and supplement them with records. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残った手袋も調査に必要だから、勝手に捨てないでくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The remaining glove is needed for the investigation too, so don't throw it away on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 残った手袋を保管して、責任者の判断まで作業を止めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 残った手袋を保管し責任者の判断を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the remaining glove and stop work until the person in charge makes a decision.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the remaining glove and await the responsible person's decision. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 残った手袋と作業記録はそのまま保管して、責任者の判断を待ってくれ。報告を受けたことを伝えてくる。では、後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep the remaining glove and work records as they are, and await the responsible person's decision. I'll tell them your report has been received. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもがトイレに行きたいそうです。家族の一人と列を離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どものトイレのため二人が列を離れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child needs the toilet. They'll leave the queue with one family member.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that two people will leave the queue for the child's toilet visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列の扱いについて確認します。何名が残られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check how the queue should be handled. How many people will remain?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二人が残ります。戻った二人が途中から入れるとは決めつけていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残る人数と途中再入列を前提にしていないことを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two will remain. I'm not assuming the two returning people can rejoin partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the number remaining and explain you are not taking rejoining the queue for granted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認が取れるまで、お戻りの際はスタッフにお声掛けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Until we've checked, please speak to staff when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもを我慢させず、先に連れていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 順番より子どものトイレを優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll take the child now instead of making them hold it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize the child's toilet needs over the place in line. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族に合流する場所もお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also tell your family where you will meet them.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻れなければ、全員で乗らず出口側で待ち合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 再入列できない場合の家族合流案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: If we can't rejoin, we won't all ride together; we'll meet on the exit side.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the family meeting plan if rejoining is not possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口側の待機場所も、表示を見て確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the signs for the waiting area on the exit side too.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ち合わせ場所を家族に伝えました。戻ったら、列へ入る前に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流点を共有して復帰時はスタッフに相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've told my family the meeting point. When we return, I'll ask before entering the queue.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share the meeting point and consult staff on returning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、まずお子様をお連れください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please take your child first. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日のご案内はお読みいただけましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 読み切れていません。朝、牛乳の入った飲物を飲みました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未読の案内と牛乳入り飲料の摂取を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I haven't finished reading them. I drank a drink containing milk this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the unread instructions and consumption of a drink containing milk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲んだ時刻と量を、医療スタッフに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the medical staff the time and amount you drank.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出発前に一杯です。水と同じだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飲んだ時刻と量と水との思い違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: One cup before leaving home. I thought it was the same as water.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when and how much you drank and your misunderstanding that it was like water. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付では検査ができるか判断できません。スタッフの案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Reception cannot decide whether the test can go ahead. Please await the medical staff's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飲んだことを隠さず相談します。予定を変える必要があれば、その説明も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 事実を隠さず検査予定変更の説明も希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll discuss it without hiding what I drank. If the schedule needs to change, I'd like to hear that explanation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Disclose the facts and request an explanation if the examination schedule must change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な対応は担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain the necessary response.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は職場にも健診予定と伝えています。変更が決まってから職場へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更確定後に職場へ連絡する意向を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've also told my workplace I'm having a health check today. I'll contact them once any change is decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you intend to contact your workplace after a change is confirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まだ変更と決まったわけではありませんので、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: A change has not been decided yet, so please wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、勝手に帰らず待ちます。ほかに飲食した物はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己判断で帰らず他の飲食の有無を補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll wait instead of leaving on my own. I haven't had anything else to eat or drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not leave at your own discretion; add whether you consumed anything else. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 飲んだ物と、ほかに飲食していないことを健診担当へ伝えます。予定が決まってから職場へご連絡ください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the health-check staff what you drank and that you haven't eaten or drunk anything else. Contact your workplace after the schedule is decided. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 棚の寸法はお部屋に合いそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do the shelf dimensions seem suitable for your room?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 置く場所には入ります。でも、共用階段を通れるかは測っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 設置場所は足りるが階段経路が未測定だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It fits in the space where I'll put it. But I haven't measured whether it can pass through the communal stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the installation space is sufficient but the stair route is unmeasured. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 搬入する経路も確認した方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You should check the delivery route too.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口だけ測れば十分だと思っていました。階段の曲がる部分も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口に加え階段の曲がり部の確認を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought measuring just the entrance was enough. Do I need to check the stair turns too?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about checking stair turns as well as the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 具体的な確認箇所は配送担当に相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's consult the delivery staff about the specific places to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は購入を決めず、何を測るか書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入を保留し配送担当から測定箇所の説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't decide to buy today. Could you write down what I need to measure?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Postpone the purchase and ask the delivery staff to explain the measuring points. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。建物側の利用条件もお調べください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with them. Please also investigate the building's usage conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理人に階段での搬入について聞きます。共用の手すりを外すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理人へ搬入条件を聞き共用設備を無断変更しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the manager about carrying it up the stairs. I don't intend to remove the communal handrail.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the manager about delivery conditions and do not alter shared facilities without permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 測定と建物への確認が済んでからご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult us after measuring and checking with the building.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。商品番号を控えて、経路の寸法を持ってまた伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品番号を控え経路寸法とともに再相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I'll note the product number and come back with the route measurements.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Note the product number and consult again with the route dimensions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認できましたらお声掛けください。またお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please let us know once you've checked. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お盆を運ぶ途中で何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did something happen while you were carrying your tray?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: つゆを床へこぼしました。次の方が通る前にお知らせしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 床につゆをこぼし次の通行前に報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I spilled broth on the floor. I wanted to tell you before the next person passes through.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the spilled broth on the floor before someone else passes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの角です。布を取りに離れると、濡れた場所が分からなくなると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: こぼした角を示し布を探して離れなかった理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: At this corner. I thought that if I left to get a cloth, people wouldn't know where the wet patch was.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the spill at the corner and explain why you did not leave to find a cloth. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 清掃係へ伝えます。お客様は濡れた所を避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the cleaning staff. Please avoid the wet area.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分で急いで拭かず、ほかの方にもこちらが濡れていると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己清掃を急がず濡れた場所を周囲にも知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I won't rush to wipe it up myself; I'll also tell other people it's wet here.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not rush to clean it yourself; alert people nearby to the wet area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お料理を持ったままでは動きにくいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's hard to move while carrying your food, isn't it?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お盆はいったんこの空いた机へ置いてよいですか。置場も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理を持つ盆の一時置場を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: May I put my tray down temporarily on this empty table? I'd like to ask where I can set it down too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about a temporary place to set the tray holding your food. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらへ置いて結構です。通路を空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can put it here. Please wait with the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 置きました。場所をお伝えしたので、係が清掃する間は通路から離れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 盆を置き場所を引き継いで清掃中の通路を空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've put it down. Now that I've told you the location, I'll leave the passage while the staff clean it.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Set down the tray, hand over the location information, and clear the passage during cleaning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こぼれた場所はこちらで対応します。お客様はお席でお待ちください。知らせてくださりありがとうございました。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll handle the spill here. Please wait at your seat. Thank you for telling us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乾杯のお飲物は、皆様同じでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would everyone like the same drink for the toast?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私はお酒を飲みません。人数分のお酒には入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一括の酒注文から自分を除外する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't drink alcohol. Please don't include me in the alcoholic drinks for the group.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Exclude yourself from the group's alcohol order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様のお飲物は、別で伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll take your drink order separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。水ではなく、メニューの温かいお茶を頼みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 温かいお茶を具体的に希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I'd like to order the hot tea on the menu rather than water.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specifically request hot tea. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらのお茶でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would this tea be all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、これです。乾杯用に別のお酒を用意する必要もありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 選択を確定し乾杯用の酒も不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, this one. There's no need to prepare a separate alcoholic drink for the toast either.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm your choice and say you do not need alcohol for the toast either. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お茶で乾杯されるということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you'll join the toast with tea?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうです。仲間にも、今日は最初から最後まで飲まないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終始飲まない方針を仲間に共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's right. I'll also tell my friends that I won't drink alcohol from start to finish today.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Share with your companions that you will abstain throughout. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、お茶を一つご用意します。

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。まとめて追加するときも、私の分は同じお茶にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加の一括注文でも自分はお茶と依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. When you take another group order, please make mine the same tea too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request tea for yourself in later group orders too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-OBAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お集まりをお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その記録、測定器の表示と合っているか。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-01.translation: Does that record match the measuring instrument's display?

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小数点の位置を一つ間違えて書きました。修正前に報告します。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 測定値の小数点転記ミスを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the decimal point one place off. I'm reporting it before correcting it.
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a decimal-point transcription error in the measurement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その値で判定まで進めたか。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you go as far as making a judgment using that value?

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。判定欄は空けてあります。実物も未判定の場所に残しています。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 判定を保留し実物も未判定で保管したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I've left the judgment field blank. The item is also still in the area for unassessed items.
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that judgment is on hold and the actual item is stored as unassessed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: なら、元の表示と記録を一緒に確認しよう。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's check the original display and record together.

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 数字を一桁ずつ読みます。点の位置も声に出して確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 桁と小数点を声に出して照合すると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll read the digits one by one. Could you also check the decimal point's position aloud?
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to compare the digits and decimal point aloud. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いいよ。転記した後に、単位も照合しよう。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sure. Let's compare the unit too after transcribing it.

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 単位は合っています。訂正は上書きで消さず、決められた記録方法に従います。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単位確認と規定どおりの訂正方法を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-08.translation: The unit is correct. I won't erase it by writing over it; I'll follow the designated record correction method.
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the unit and show you will use the prescribed correction method. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうしてくれ。判定は訂正後に担当へ回そう。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Let's send it to the person in charge for judgment after the correction.

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 訂正理由を残して回します。次の測定前に記録欄も見直します。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正理由を残し次の記録欄を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the correction reason in the record and pass it on. I'll also review the recording field before the next measurement.
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the correction reason and review the next recording field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正理由を残した記録を担当へ回してくれ。未判定として扱い、次の測定前にも欄を確認しよう。では、また後で。
DLG-SC-FKI-SABAE-001-SHARED-11.translation: Pass the record with the correction reason to the person in charge. Treat it as unassessed and check the field before the next measurement too. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I have the name on your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 田中です。検査の予約ですが、昨日から新しく見え方が変わりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査予約後に見え方が変化したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tanaka. I'm booked for a test, but my vision has changed since yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your vision changed after booking the test. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約された内容とは別の変化ですね。担当にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is a new change separate from your booked test, then. I'll tell the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予定の検査だけ受けて帰ってよいのか、先生に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定検査だけで帰らず医師に相談したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to ask the doctor whether it's all right to just have the scheduled test and go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to consult a doctor rather than leave after only the scheduled test. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのような変化か、伺える範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me what you can about the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 片方だけぼやけます。昨日の夕方からで、今日はまだ続いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 症状の左右と開始時刻と持続を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only one eye is blurry. It started yesterday evening and is still continuing today.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the side affected, onset time, and persistence of the symptom. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経過を医療スタッフに伝えます。受付では原因は判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the medical staff that course of events. Reception cannot determine the cause.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 原因を決めつけず、始まった時刻と左右をそのまま説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原因を推測せず観察した経過を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't assume a cause; I'll explain the starting time and side exactly as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the observed course without guessing the cause. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察のご案内が出るまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait until we give you instructions about seeing the doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。検査だけの予約だったことも、診察でお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約内容も診察時に説明すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll also explain during the consultation that my appointment was only for a test.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will also explain your appointment type during the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい症状の時刻と左右、検査予約で来られたことを担当へ伝えます。診察の案内までお待ちください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge the new symptom's timing and side and that you came for a test appointment. Please wait for consultation instructions. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: まず道具の持ち方をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: First, I'll show you how to hold the tool.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は左利きです。同じ向きで持つと手元が見えにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 左利きでは実演どおりだと見えにくいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm left-handed. If I hold it in the same orientation, it's hard to see what my hands are doing.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that following the demonstration exactly makes it hard to see because you are left-handed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に真似せず、一度道具を置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't force yourself to copy it. Please put the tool down for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 置きました。反対の手で材料を押さえる位置も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 道具を置き材料を押さえる手の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've put it down. Does the position of the other hand holding the material also change?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Put the tool down and ask about the hand position for holding the material. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う道具に合わせて確認します。左右だけを反転すればよいとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check according to the tool being used. Simply reversing left and right isn't always enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自己判断で反転しないで、私の手で持つところを見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単純反転を避け自分の姿勢の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than reverse it on my own, I'd like you to watch how I hold it with my own hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid a simple reversal and request a check of your own posture. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、動かさず持つ姿勢から見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let's start with the holding posture without moving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この姿勢なら見えます。ただ、隣の人に肘が近いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 姿勢改善後の隣席との肘の近さを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can see in this posture. But my elbow is close to the person next to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report your elbow's proximity to the next person after improving your posture. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 作業の間隔も調整してから始めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's adjust the spacing between work areas before starting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所を整えていただいてから練習します。速さより持ち方を先に覚えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 作業間隔を整えて持ち方から練習すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll practice after you've arranged the space. I'll learn the grip before focusing on speed.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to arrange work spacing and practice the grip first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 左手の持ち方が見える位置と、肘がぶつからない間隔を整えます。練習は準備ができてから始めましょう。それでは、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll arrange a position where you can see your left-hand grip and enough space so elbows don't collide. Let's begin practicing once we're ready. Please excuse me for now.
